sections.hypothesis: When price closes decisively above a falling trendline drawn through the two most recent known lower swing highs, the breakout reaches 3R more often than its cost-adjusted break-even rate (about 26%).
sections.rationale: The breakout marks the end of a sequence of lower highs: sellers stop pressing, and momentum and stop-buying from shorts may follow. It is the trendline version of a plain breakout, so the real question is whether the line adds anything over a horizontal channel high. Weak point: many breaks of a falling line are just pauses in the down-trend.
sections.rules: Shared definitions: 4h bars; swing high/low = a bar's high (low) beats the 3 bars before it and isn't beaten by the 3 bars after it, known only 3 bars later; ATR = 14-bar average true range at the signal bar. Lines and levels use only swings known at the signal bar. Buy at the next open; risk 1% per trade (spot, no leverage); one position at a time. Line: through the two most recent known swing highs, where the later one is lower, projected forward. Breakout: a close more than 0.5 ATR above the projected line. That close is the signal. Stop: the lowest low since the later swing high. Target: 3R. One entry per line.
sections.falsification: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT 4h, 2020-01 to 2025-10 (before the holdout), default parameters, run once. Reject if, pooled across both markets: net expectancy after costs is 0R or below; or P(expectancy > 0) is under 90%; or fewer than 50 trades; or it doesn't beat the channel-breakout engine test with a 3R target and 1% risk on the same data (a horizontal 20-bar high instead of a falling line).
sections.parameters: swing_bars 3 (2-5); breakout_atr_pct 50 (25-100); target_r 3 (2-4). Comparison: channel-breakout with lookback 20, stop_lookback 10, target_r 3. Only the defaults are pre-registered.
sections.costs: The stop sits at a recent low, which can be far below a breakout close: often 5-10% on 4h, so costs are small, about 0.02-0.05R. Wide stops also mean smaller positions and some trades capped by cash. Expect 1-3 setups a month per market.
